verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an error-monitoring platform, but the evidence pack never documents linking issues to Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear, nor any two-way status sync. The only nearby material is adjacent: an Issue Status page title, Slack/PagerDuty notification integrations, generic webhooks, and a pricing line about "third-party integrations". None of these is evidence of ticket linking or resolve/reopen sync.
